Midland tag screen — review cards (round 1)

Built 2026-10-26T21:49:03-05:00, git 3a355f6+dirty, read-only; 28,859 producing horizontals as of 2026-09-01. Rule A: the well sits in another bench's local band (1.5-mi consensus) and at least one vote that does not come from the neighbours' tags agrees (the other vendor's label, sql/23 nearest, GOR). Rule B: Novi and Enverus disagree and the neighbourhood cannot confirm the tag (off band / ambiguous / no evidence); destination = the other vendor's bench. Mark each card agree / reject in cards_sample.csv (column verdict). Sequential: 5 cards per class; 5/5 agree accepts, 0–1/5 rejects, otherwise 5 more and the class is judged at 7/10. Accepted classes become warehouse tag overrides (ref.formation_tag_overrides) on your go; everything else keeps its tag. Star = subject; dots = wells within 1.5 mi coloured by tag (hollow = not clean evidence); dashed = local band medians.

1,526 flagged (885 rule A, 641 rule B) in 98 classes; 56 classes (1,042 wells) touch the Wolfcamp; 21 of them carded (≥ 5 cohort wells), 35 listed only. Spraberry-only classes: 20b.
